It looks like there’s a mix‑up in the numbers you mentioned!  
**Boston’s climate**:

| Season | Typical Highs |
|--------|---------------|
| Summer (June–August) | **70 °F – 85 °F** (≈ 21 °C – 29 °C) |
| Winter (December–February) | **30 °F – 40 °F** (≈ −1 °C – 4 °C) |

So while it can feel warm—especially on humid days—the highest recorded temperatures rarely exceed **90 °F (32 °C)**. A “54 °C” reading would be far above anything historically observed in Boston. If you’re planning travel or events, keep an eye on local forecasts; heat advisories usually kick in when daytime highs approach the upper 80s/low 90s.
